projects.title: Naramata Vineyard BnB
projects.description: A modern Bed and Breakfast booking application built with Next.js for fast, SEO-friendly performance. This project integrates Google Calendar for real-time availability, ensuring seamless booking management. Styled with Tailwind CSS for a sleek, responsive design and developed using TypeScript for scalability and reliability.

projects.title: Ryga Arts Festival
projects.description: A visually stunning and easy-to-manage website for the Ryga Arts Festival, built with Webflow for a seamless, no-code experience. Designed to highlight festival events, artist showcases, and ticketing information while ensuring an intuitive and engaging user experience.

projects.title: Pokédex App
projects.description: A fun and interactive Pokédex built with React and styled using Sass. This project fetches real-time Pokémon data and provides detailed stats, abilities, and images. Deployed on GitHub Pages for easy access.
